operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: A native local PG17 proof applied all original 31 Office forward migrations on an occupied 0046 fixture, and a separately recoverable owner-held encrypted backup of the managed Fresh Install application schemas now exists. However, Fresh Install is still on original 0046 with 175 public, two private tables and an empty migration ledger. No independently bound exact-source managed release candidate or irreversible hosted go/no-go record currently ties original 31 bytes, current managed identity, catalog, restore artifact and runtime proof; executing DDL now could compromise the source provenance or lose recovery.
observableOutcomes: An independently verified read-only snapshot identifies the exact Supabase Fresh Install project and 0046 schema, including existing auth/storage/provider-trigger invariants and 113 neutral catalog records.
All original 78 migration source paths and 31 forward files are bound in original pinned order, with byte hashes and no rewrite, omission or duplication.

No read-only workflow may apply migrations, change Supabase migrations ledger, perform DDL, start staging or touch platform project.
